subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft for Clearsight Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@clearsighthealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearsighthealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft for Clearsight Health

Hi Sasha / Tom —

Thanks again for the great discovery call today. Per our discussion I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that lays out milestones, owners, dependencies, and two timeline options so we can align on a target close date. Happy to iterate — this is intended to be a working document to keep everyone coordinated.

Highlights (from call):
- Primary objective: Production LLM inference for patient triage workflows (low-latency, HIPAA controls).
- Dependencies we flagged: SOC 2 evidence, VPC peering/network review, PO/procurement timeline, internal security review.
- Success criteria: <10% regression vs. current heuristics on triage accuracy, 99th pct latency target <= 400ms, and established rollout plan for one pilot clinic.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_DRAFT_CLEARSIGHT_v1.xlsx (initial milestones + owners). Also included our standard SOW template for reference.

Proposed target-close options (see MAP tab):
A) Accelerated — Target close: 2026-09-30 (requires immediate security kickoff and prioritized procurement).
B) Standard — Target close: 2026-10-15 (adds two-week buffer for network testing and procurement).

Ask:
1) Please confirm which timeline (A or B) you prefer or propose an alternate target date.
2) Confirm the stakeholders I should include on the MAP (security, procurement, engineering contacts).
3) Any missing dependencies we should add or items to reprioritize.

Next steps if A/B confirmed:
- I’ll update the MAP with confirmed owners and dates and circulate the MAP as the canonical tracker.
- Aditya (cc’d) will coordinate any pricing/contract timeline questions. Neha (cc’d) will be the CS lead for pilot planning.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- Redwood_MAP_DRAFT_CLEARSIGHT_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 35KB)
- SOW-template.pdf (pdf, 240KB)
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@clearsighthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearsighthealth.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearsighthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft for Clearsight Health

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary and thanks to the team for the quick turn.

Quick responses:
- We prefer timeline option B (Target close: 2026-10-15) to give our network/security team time for peering and the SOC evidence review.
- Please add our security lead, Lena Ortiz (cc’d), as the owner for the security milestone.
- Procurement will likely need a 3–4 week window to get a PO approved — I’ll confirm a target date by EOD Wednesday.

Also one ask: can you add a short row in the MAP for our success criteria sign-off (who signs off from our side)? I think that will help avoid ambiguity later.

Thanks — copying Tom and Lena to keep everyone aligned.

Thanks Sasha — great, appreciate the quick clarity. I updated the MAP draft with the following changes and will publish the v1.1 after you confirm the PO/approval timing:

What I changed (v1.1 preview):
- Timeline: set to Option B — Target close: 2026-10-15.
- Security owner: Lena Ortiz added to the security milestone and SOC 2 evidence row.
- Procurement: added a 3–4 week procurement milestone; please confirm the PO date when you have it and I’ll adjust the plan.
- Success sign-off: added a "Customer Sign-Off" row — please specify the person (name & title) who will be responsible for final acceptance.

Immediate next steps / owners:
- Sasha: Confirm PO target date by EOD Wed (owner: Sasha).
- Lena: Kick off security intake and confirm expected timeline for SOC 2 artifacts (owner: Lena).
- Aditya (Redwood): I’ll work with you on the draft commercial timeline and draft redlines if purchasing wants them early.
- Neha (Redwood CS): Will schedule a pilot scoping call once procurement date is clearer.

I’ll attach v1.1 once I get the procurement target — when confirmed I’ll also create a shared Drive MAP (link below) and a HubSpot deal update so this stays in the CRM. Feel free to reply-all with any edits.

Links / artifacts:
- MAP (working copy, v1.1 to follow): https://docs.redwood.com/drive/clearsight/MAP_v1
- HubSpot deal: HubSpot-67842

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
